before_statement: If a nonzero Noetherian local ring $A$ is a quotient of at least one regular local ring, then the least dimension of a regular local ring surjecting onto $A$ is $\operatorname{edim}A$.
after_statement: Assume the Axiom of Choice ([[def-axiom-of-choice]]). If a nonzero Noetherian local ring $A$ is a quotient of at least one regular local ring, then the least dimension of a regular local ring surjecting onto $A$ is $\operatorname{edim}A$.
